qa_pairs.question: What screw size and torque is used for the 4HP-22/4HP-24/A5S 310Z/A5S 440Z/A5S 300J valve body to transmission connection?
How many different torque specifications are shown for the A5S 560Z valve body to transmission?
qa_pairs.answer: Two specifications: 6 Nm with M6 x 12 screw and 8 Nm with M6x55 screw.

qa_pairs.question: What is the torque specification for valve housing to valve body for all transmission types?
Which transmission type uses a 5/16" screw for the valve body to transmission connection?
What is the difference in torque between the 3HP-22 and 4HP-22 valve body to transmission connections?
qa_pairs.answer: The 3HP-22 uses 11 Nm while the 4HP-22 uses 8 Nm, both with M6 screws.

qa_pairs.question: Which component uses reference 3AZ in the torque specifications?
qa_pairs.answer: Adapter plate on shift unit for the A4S 270R/A4S 310R transmission.
